critical_code_review_comments: server.py:84-86 correctly separates ENROLLMENT_INTEGRATION_DEFAULT_KEY / ENROLLMENT_KEY_FROM_ENV / ENROLLMENT_INTEGRATION_KEY, so /api/health can honestly report key_source ∈ {'env','built-in default'} without ever leaking the value.

server.py:854, 890 hard-code demo_mode=false in the public health and admin diagnostics payloads — matches the v7 spec that the global demo switch was removed.
_server_env_report never returns raw env values; DEPLOY_ENV_KEYS is a fixed allow-list of KEY NAMES only — /api/health body is safe to expose publicly.

Key invariants: (a) /api/health.demo_mode is ALWAYS false in v7; (b) /api/health.integration.key_source reflects env vs built-in default; (c) OTP_DEMO_MODE env is IGNORED and never surfaced in env_keys_present/missing, but if OTP_DEMO_MODE=true is set a warning is emitted; (d) _is_demo_phone consults ONLY OTP_DEMO_PHONES allow-list — safe demo phones are 9999999999, 8888888888, 7777777777, 6666666666, 8888800001, 8888800002; (e) built-in default integration key = CVO6i5qVspaaYOtn9Esh-KPOHmrgtI9Z4-KYFFtSJGUxeKmR; never call send-otp for 8888800077 (it's for integration endpoints only) or for other real numbers.
